goal: Add useful decision support to the existing service-areas ranking page.
summary: The areas page now tells prospective clients which project details help distinguish remote work from selectively scoped local capture.
risk: Focused additive copy on one existing route; metadata, offers, and URL inventory remain unchanged.
public_claims: The new guidance is limited to the location and project-scoping facts already published on the page and in repository rules.

evidence.obsidian_context: Repository rules, client hot status, project index, agent guide, and current repository handoff were reviewed before implementation.
evidence.project_routing: The change is confined to app/(english)/areas/page.tsx, the source for the existing /areas route.
evidence.hard_stops_checked: No new client result, fixed rate, public location detail, review, availability statement, equipment assertion, or strengthened Palm Beach positioning was added.
evidence.reviewer_ensemble: Builder validation and an independent scope, claims, duplication, and editorial review completed; the larger draft was rejected and narrowed to one evidence-grounded section.
evidence.reviewer_disagreement_reviewed: The independent reviewer found existing county, remote/local, and Miami proof coverage already substantive; the implementation removed duplicated sections and retained only the missing inquiry-scoping answer.
evidence.winner_rationale: The final section answers what a prospective client should provide, uses existing route facts, and adds two useful internal paths without changing the page's established positioning.
evidence.tests_or_validation: pnpm check passed: lint and typecheck clean, 51 test files / 400 tests passing, and the 297-page production build successful; git diff --check passed.
evidence.debt_delta: Adds 39 lines to one existing page with no dependency, metadata, schema, route, or inventory change.
evidence.obsidian_handoff: Project notes were reviewed; external vault writes were excluded by the dispatch workspace boundary.
evidence.claim_hygiene_checked: Compared every new sentence with the existing remote editing, local capture, confirmed-service, and service-area language in the route and repository rules.
evidence.data_sources_current: Live same-property GSC date,page read for 2026-05-22 through 2026-08-20 returned 62 impressions, 0 clicks, and weighted position 9.2097 for /areas, across 2026-07-24 through 2026-08-19.
evidence.booking_or_authority_thesis: Clear inquiry inputs should help qualified service-area searchers understand the next step and choose between the existing contact and service-comparison paths.
evidence.ci_passed: All local repository gates passed; GitHub checks are running for PR-127.
evidence.pr_review_complete: Independent scope and editorial review completed; the final one-section diff reflects the review's recommendation.
evidence.deploy_or_rollback_plan: Merge through the standard repository PR lane after green checks; reverting commit 9a9ce53 restores the prior page.
evidence.post_change_verification: After merge, fetch /areas and confirm HTTP 200, the new heading and both internal paths, plus unchanged canonical and metadata.
